# Arabic speech fixture

`sample1.wav` is Cohere's unmodified 113,964-byte example from `CohereLabs/cohere-transcribe-arabic-07-2026`, distributed under Apache-2.0, copyright Cohere. It is copied from tafrigh-cohere's fixture, originally retrieved from the [Newmetrics mirror at revision 35dbaf071fb0eec23ae1fdcbf671d469bc607e5c](https://huggingface.co/Newmetrics/cohere-transcribe-arabic-07-2026/blob/35dbaf071fb0eec23ae1fdcbf671d469bc607e5c/examples/sample1.wav). The license is in `LICENSE-APACHE-2.0`.

SHA-256: `14ce25757caa30e7e39a8ec75cb05fdc7838e92ad0c6619e9c0697515779adaa`. The real-model test resamples it with ffmpeg to mono 16 kHz F32 and checks finite generation with Arabic output. No model files are bundled.
